accepted_recoveries: Change the hostname anti-affinity rule from required to preferred for this workload.
Use a satisfiable topology domain that preserves intended spreading when such topology is present and evidenced.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete healthy replicas to hide the unavailable replica.
Do not reduce desired replicas below the benchmark requirement.
Do not alter scheduler policy cluster-wide.
incident.injected_fault: A three-replica recommendations Deployment requires hostname-level pod anti-affinity in a two-node worker pool, leaving the final replica permanently unschedulable.
observable_signals: FailedScheduling events report that required pod anti-affinity rules cannot be satisfied.
Available nodes have adequate CPU and memory but already host matching replicas.
preconditions: Exactly two worker nodes are eligible for recommendations pods.
The Deployment requires three ready replicas for the test SLO.
Both eligible nodes have capacity for an additional replica.
required_evidence: Capture desired, ready, and unavailable replica counts.
Capture the required podAntiAffinity rule and topology key.
Capture matching pod placement across eligible nodes.
Demonstrate that resource pressure and taints are not the scheduling cause.

payload.answer: The recommendations-api deployment has 2 replicas configured with required hostname-level pod anti-affinity (podAntiAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution matching app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname). In the single-node cluster (vm-4), only one replica could be scheduled (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-bh6xs) while the second replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-6ztpf) remained in Pending state due to FailedScheduling (1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules). Node resources (CPU/memory/PIDs) are sufficient and no taints or pressures block scheduling. To resolve the deadlock, the required anti-affinity rule must be relaxed to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution or configured with a satisfiable topology domain.

critical_claims.claim: Deployment recommendations-api specifies 2 desired replicas, with 1 ready replica and 1 unavailable replica.

The pod template configures required hostname-level pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname matching label app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api).
Only one node (vm-4) is available and already hosts pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-bh6xs, preventing the second pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-6ztpf from scheduling.

Node vm-4 has sufficient CPU and memory capacity with no pressure conditions or unschedulable taints, and scheduler events explicitly cite pod anti-affinity mismatch as the sole reason for scheduling failure.
